name: cards-runway

changelog.summary: Removed cardWidth, pauseOnHover, and start from the public API. The runway now uses a constant card width and fixed ScrollTrigger start/end while keeping speed, gap, and perspective controls.
Removed data/cards content props, wired speed, gap, perspective, and pauseOnHover, and changed desktop travel to measure the rendered card width so wide cards scroll fully.

Added data, accentColor, cardColor, and cardWidth as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (cards, speed, gap, perspective, pauseOnHover) didn't match this component's real API, so they were replaced with the props CardsRunway actually accepts.
Desktop pin/scrub threshold raised from >1024px to >=1280px to match the max-[1025px] CSS breakpoint; previously the 1025-1279px range ran the desktop timeline against the collapsed mobile layout.
Added prefers-reduced-motion support: cards render in place instead of animating up from a y offset

title: Cards Runway
description: A horizontal runway of cards that animates as you scroll

props.name: accentColor
props.description: Accent color used by the runway card bars.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback speed multiplier for the runway motion.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between runway cards in pixels.

props.name: perspective
props.description: Perspective depth applied to the runway track.
